tools.name: wedmaroc_estimate_budget
tools.description: Computes a realistic 2026 Moroccan wedding budget breakdown in MAD (including catering tables, venue, neggafa, mahr/gold, photo/video, orchestra, henna, sweets, dfou, and 5% emergency reserve) adjusted by city cost multiplier.

tools.name: wedmaroc_list_cities
tools.description: Lists major Moroccan cities with their 2026 cost multipliers, average wedding totals in MAD, and canonical WedMaroc city guide URLs.

tools.name: wedmaroc_get_vendor_prices
tools.description: Returns 2026 price benchmarks and canonical WedMaroc URLs for Moroccan wedding vendor categories (traiteur, neggafa, salle-des-fetes, photographe, orchestre, decoration, coiffure, patisserie, couture-caftan, voiture).

tools.name: wedmaroc_list_tools
tools.description: Returns canonical URLs for all free client-side WedMaroc tools (Budget Calculator, Seating Chart Planner, Who Pays What / Qui Paie Quoi, Wedding Invitation Card Generator, and Mahr Guide) in AR, FR, or EN.
